accessibility:
- The `label` prop is automatically associated with the inner text input (`htmlFor` plus a generated `id`, or your own `id` if you pass one), so clicking the label focuses the input and assistive technology announces it.
- A user-supplied `id` is applied to the inner input (the labellable control), not the wrapper div.
- Uses `role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded`
- Has `aria-haspopup="listbox"` and `aria-autocomplete="list"`
- Dropdown items use `role="option"` with `aria-selected`
- Disabled items have `aria-disabled`
- Full keyboard navigation support
summary: The `Autocomplete` component provides an input field with dropdown suggestions that filter based on user input.

parts.summary: The `Autocomplete` component provides an input field with dropdown suggestions that filter based on user input.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Automatically associated with the text input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. Dropped inside an outer `Field` (label that `Field` yourself).

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then).

props.name: id
props.description: Applied to the inner text input (the labellable control), not the wrapper div.

props.name: field
props.description: Object property to use as the display field.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Whether to show a clear button.

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Open dropdown when input is focused.

props.name: selectOnClickOutside
props.description: Select highlighted item on click outside.

props.name: checkInfiniteScroll
props.description: Enables infinite scroll detection in the dropdown.

props.name: infiniteScrollDistance
props.description: Distance in pixels from the bottom to trigger `onInfiniteScroll`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Forwarded to the inner `<input>`.

props.name: form
props.description: Optional id of the form the input belongs to.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required for native HTML form validation.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Callback when dropdown active state changes.

props.name: onInfiniteScroll
props.description: Callback when scrolled to bottom (infinite scroll).

props.name: empty
props.description: Content to show when no results.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label (used in horizontal layouts).

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the input element.
